findings.pagination: None found live (no <link rel="next">, no 'next' nav item) — a single fetch is genuinely complete.
findings.stable_identifier: Each event's own WordPress post id, embedded directly in id="post-{id}" on its wrapping <div> — read literally, never derived from title/slug.
findings.date_time: Each card's own <span class="tribe-event-date-start"> carries 'D Month, HH:MM' for a same-year event (no year digits at all) or 'D Month YYYY, HH:MM' for a different-year one. This collector combines the card's own text with its governing <h2> month/year section header — both read directly from the page — to derive a full calendar date; a card/header month mismatch fails closed rather than guessing. See ingestion/super-bock-arena/discovery.mjs and observation-adapter.mjs doc comments for the full live-evidence writeup, including the off-by-one header-attribution bug this collector deliberately avoids (a header can render as TRAILING content inside the PRECEDING event's own block).
findings.music_filtering: This venue's own tribe-events-category-{slug} classes are a genuine first-party taxonomy — MUSIC_CATEGORY_SLUGS (pop-rock, musica-brasileira, musica-portuguesa, eletronica, fado, classica, forro, sertanejo, concertos-en) are retained; gaming/circo/stand-up-comedy/danca/infantil-2/musical are genuinely excluded live examples (BLAST Premier esports, Cirque du Soleil, Eros Prado stand-up, Music Circus Show on Ice, Patrulha Pata ao Vivo).
findings.venue_identity: Every card on this one listing page is this one physical arena — resolved by source_id via a NEW data-driven mapping entry (venues/source-venue-mappings.json), not a new hardcoded ingestion/venue/resolver.mjs branch.
